# Colorado.gov

> > Colorado.gov is the official state portal providing comprehensive access to government services, employment benefits, business resources, education programs, and resident services across Colorado state agencies.

Colorado.gov serves as the primary digital gateway for Colorado residents, businesses, and visitors to access state services. The platform integrates major services including the Colorado DMV, MyUI+ unemployment insurance, myColorado identity verification, and PEAK benefits portal, alongside resources for employment, education, business registration, and tourism information.

## Key Topics

- Colorado.gov
- DMV services
- Government services
- State benefits
- MyUI+ unemployment
- myColorado
- PEAK benefits portal

- Secretary of State

## Main Service Portals

- [Home](https://co.colorado.gov): Colorado state homepage with links to major services like DMV, myColorado, and PEAK
- [Government](https://co.colorado.gov/government): Government services portal for Colorado agencies, benefits, and online services
- [Residents](https://co.colorado.gov/residents): Resident services including DMV, rental assistance, and community programs

## Employment & Benefits

- [Employment](https://co.colorado.gov/employment): Employment services including MyUI+ benefits and job search resources

## Business & Economic Development

- [Business](https://co.colorado.gov/business): Business resources including registration, licensing, and economic development support

## Education & Learning

- [Education](https://co.colorado.gov/education): Education hub for K-12, higher education, and degree/certificate programs

## Tourism & Recreation

- [Visitors](https://co.colorado.gov/visitors): Colorado tourism and visitor information for outdoor recreation and parks

## News & Updates

- [Articles](https://co.colorado.gov/articles): News articles and press releases from Colorado state agencies

## Support & Information

- [Contact Us](https://co.colorado.gov/contact-us): Contact information and technical support for Colorado.gov services
- [Supported Browsers](https://co.colorado.gov/supported-browsers): Supported browser compatibility for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge

## Optional

- [Accessibility Standards](https://co.colorado.gov/accessibility-standards): WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards and disability accommodation information
- [General Notices](https://co.colorado.gov/general-notices): Privacy policy and data collection practices for Colorado.gov
- [Legal Notices](https://co.colorado.gov/legal-notices): Copyright, DMCA, and intellectual property legal notices
- [Linking Policy](https://co.colorado.gov/linking-policy): External linking policy and disclaimer for third-party websites
